more.def: A machine with sharp blades that cuts grass on a lawn or a field.
examples: Dad pushed the mower across the lawn on Saturday.
The mower made a loud noise.
A ride-on mower cut the big field.

easy.def: A soft white cheese used on pizza.
examples: Pizza has mozzarella.
The mozzarella is white.
I like mozzarella.

more.def: A soft, white, mild cheese that melts well and is used on pizza.
examples: The pizza was topped with melted mozzarella.
Mozzarella is soft and stretchy.
We ate mozzarella sticks at the party.
